limits: Only scalar 16/24-bit forms and non-windowed CALL0/RET.N; no FLIX, custom instruction, call4/8/12 window semantics.
CALL0 target is aligned inst_start plus signed18<<2 plus4; byte/word guesses are not Java API evidence.
cpu_boundary: SDK selection only, no CPU execution

function_bound_policy: Half-open byte ranges; SuperH includes intrinsic return/call delay slots; Hexagon consists only of complete one-word packets.
